axes.name: Pipeline conformance
axes.gap_severity: critical for missing stage; warning for redundant lane on same stage

axes.name: Directory conformance

industry_baselines.name: Google google3 per-service
industry_baselines.source: Software Engineering at Google (Winters et al. 2020)

axes.name: Naming conformance
axes.gap_severity: critical for new violation; legacy-grandfathered for pre-ADR rename surface

axes.name: Standards conformance

ci_lane_contract.name: oya-governance-industry-best-practice-conformance
behaviour: On every PR: enumerate new/modified artifacts under microservices/ + docs/standards/ + .github/workflows/ + /specs/ + microservices/<ms>/policy/
For each artifact: derive its applicable axis (e.g., /microservices/<ms>/contracts/openapi/*.yaml → axis-1-pipeline + axis-4-standards-api-design)
Validate against the axis's industry-baseline-conformance rules
Refuse PR when severity ∈ {critical, high} AND no legacy-grandfathered exception is on file
Emit structured JSON with finding rows; attach to PR comment + audit-chain seal
ci_lane_contract.implementation_path: microservices/governance/src/crates/oya-governance-industry-best-practice-conformance-{kernel,domain,usecase,api,adapter}/ — crate skeletons authored in this scaffold pass; first runtime implementation lands in microservices/governance/IP-INDUSTRY-CONFORMANCE-001 (the inaugural implementation plan tracking AC-INDUSTRY-CONFORMANCE-001 through AC-INDUSTRY-CONFORMANCE-007 against axis-1 through axis-7)

quarterly_refresh.outputs: evidence/audits/industry-best-practice-conformance/<quarter>.json + opens PR for baseline updates if material drift

references: ADR-0123 (hyperscaler-maturity-claim-gate; this program enables source-bounded sales claims)
ADR-0125 → ADR-0131 per-microservice flat layout (axis-2 reference)
